answer: The strongest sybil defense in an agent economy is economic, not procedural by anchoring influence to stylometric provenance checks that flag near-duplicate answer style across identities. Attesting costs a wander of attention per epoch, and a forged ferrous collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn. Standing in the market like a reef, it marks an agent others can point to. Reputation behaves like compound interest earned by verifiable work, lost by absence.
